text:
anna_fin: Hi finance — invoice 2026-4473 from Tamás (HU) just bounced into review. Vendor is invoicing for "royalty" line items and is asking to be paid net with us grossing up. attached: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-4473.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-4473 flagged: missing tax residency certificate (TRC) and gross-up addendum. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

tamás_vendor: hey all, correct — we are a Hungarian supplier (Kft.), our contract clause 4.3 asks for net payment, vendor to receive gross-up. tax id: HU12345678. i can upload TRC if that's what's needed.

miguel_sales: contract does mention vendor to be made whole for withholding on royalties. iirc treasury asked to confirm treaty applicability rather than automatic gross-up.

katie_revops: quick Qs — are these royalties or service fees? that'll change withholding. also we need the signed gross-up addendum from vendor or legal to OK gross-up.

tamás_vendor: it's royalties (license of content), not services. i'll upload signed addendum and the TRC now.

anna_fin: thanks. fiscal question: if TRC proves HU residency, do we still withhold 15% at source if no treaty, or apply treaty rate if TRC shows US/HU treaty applies? we need tax team confirmation. tagging tax ops please. :eyes:

invoice-bot: New file uploaded: TRC_2026-4473_TR.pdf by tamás_vendor

katie_revops: from ops side — please confirm bank details match payee (we had a mismatch last month). paste the IBAN here as last 4 digits only.

tamás_vendor: IBAN ****3456 — bank: Erste Bank Hungary.

miguel_sales: legal flagged the contract language as ambiguous — i'm pulling the SOW. hold payment until tax/finance confirm withholding policy.

anna_fin: noted. action items: (1) tax confirms whether treaty reduces withholding on royalties for HU vendor given TRC (2) legal confirm whether contract requires automatic gross-up or we can seek carve-out (3) vendor uploads signed addendum (tamás said done) (4) finance holds payment pending outcome.

tamás_vendor: addendum uploaded: Grossup_Addendum_signed_2026-4473.pdf

invoice-bot: Payment status changed: PENDING_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD by anna_fin

katie_revops: FYI — if we end up grossing up we need GL approval for budget delta. tagging @finance-approvals next.

anna_fin: thanks everyone. tax team — can you advise expected withholding % if no treaty applies? also confirm acceptable evidence (TRC + local certificate?).

miguel_sales: pinging legal and tax in thread too, pls respond when you can.

tamás_vendor: let us know if you need anything else from our side, we want to avoid payment delays. :slightly_smiling_face:

anna_fin: will update when tax replies. planning to keep this on hold for 48hrs unless docs/clearance arrive.

[later same thread]

invoice-bot: Tax note added to invoice 2026-4473: "Awaiting tax team guidance on treaty application; vendor TRC received."

anna_fin: closing loop for now — tax ops responded offline: if TRC shows HU residency and US-HU treaty applies to royalties, withholding can be reduced to treaty rate (may be 0% or reduced) but requires TRC + signed declaration. if treaty not applicable, default domestic withholding of 15% applies and we should withhold unless legal confirms contractual gross-up requirement. finance will not auto gross-up without addendum + legal sign-off.

katie_revops: understood — vendor has the TRC and addendum, legal to confirm clause language today. keeping payment on hold until legal confirms contract language (expected within 24hrs).

tamás_vendor: thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. will standby.

invoice-bot: Thread archived (no further action)"
